rows.en: Bushido... is found... in death... Bushido is...
You would turn your back on your enemy!!
Very well! Make your preparations! I shall wait!
Do you mean to insult me!? Bring 00 to me!!
Completed the quest "Duel with Masurao 2".
00 must be in the party to progress this quest.
I have been waiting.
Susanowo, what are you planning?
Gundam, I would have you answer my wish.
I have been waiting.
You... what are you planning?
Gundam, I would have you answer my wish.
What is it you want?
A duel in deadly earnest...
What!?
I, Susanowo, demand a duel with you!
You want to settle this that badly!?
Naturally! The ones who captivated my heart and shattered my warrior's spirit were none other than
you Gundams!
Indeed. It has surpassed love, transcended even hatred, and become destiny!
Destiny!?
Indeed! You and I are bound to do battle!
(I see... He is a being that we distorted...)
Understood. I accept your duel.
I ask for nothing less than your all!
Hey! You're really gonna fight him!?
There is no other way.
This is the path I desire... the path of the Asura!

[00] 00...
[Susanowo] Susanowo...

[00] The target...
[Susanowo] Fair and square...

[00] ...will be eliminated!
[Susanowo] ...let us duel!
Fight, Gundam! Cut me down and show me you can seize victory with your own hands!
Why!? Why do you not finish me!?
I will live. I will live, and seize tomorrow.
That is my fight. Fight in order to live.
Kh!
Bushido... is found... in death... Bushido is...
Obtained "Unryu".
Completed the quest "A Challenge Letter for 00".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
Altron is reportedly under attack. Hear details from Maganac at the Veda Cube Upper Layer entrance.
We've been waiting for you. If you'll permit me, I'll get straight to the point.
We've lost contact with Altron Gundam, who has been fighting battle after battle on his own.
According to the others, he most likely headed for the deepest part of Veda Cube.
Please find Altron Gundam and back him up.
Mission accepted.
Please come again, and bring Wing Zero with you.
This is the area. Commencing operation.
Why the hell is Altron Gundam running around on his own?
...He's always been like that. Even we rarely fought alongside him.
He acts on his own convictions. No one can tie him down.
Hah, what's that supposed to mean?
That's just the kind of guy he is.
Combat level, target confirmed. Commencing elimination.
Outta the way, outta the way! The God of Death is comin' through!!
Sorry, but I'm cuttin' in~
Deathscythe... What are you doing here?
I heard about Altron.
So I figured I'd lend you a hand and came all the way out here.
Are your wounds all right?
I've rested plenty already.
Altron's got a habit of pushin' himself way too far.
We can't afford to sit around!
Anyway, leave this place to me and hurry on over to him.
...Understood.
Hey, you seriously plan to go ahead with this job without Wing Zero?
Confirmed: Altron, and an enemy mobile doll unit of Virgos.
I am Altron! I will neither run nor hide!!
Not yet... I'll keep fighting until I've crushed every last evil!
Altron!?
There he is! Hey! Let's hurry!
Them again!? Get out of my way!
...At this rate, we'll lose sight of Altron!
Leave this to us!
Looks like we can't afford to rest up after all.
Now, go on ahead!
You two as well...
